dedupe_keys.name: nube dbbm numerical benchmark for drive by bridge monitoring methods

description: A Norwegian University of Science and Technology researcher publishes NuBe-DBBM, simulated vehicle responses for drive-by bridge-damage monitoring. Zenodo lists scenario archives under CC BY 4.0. Its description reports 518,400 MATLAB event files spanning six bridge lengths, two monitoring setups, damage locations and magnitudes, vehicle models, road profiles and speeds. Each event represents a crossing of a two-dimensional vehicle-bridge interaction model. These outputs can benchmark damage-detection algorithms and structural-monitoring simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this numerical collection. Coverage is the selected synthetic bridges and parameter grid, not an observed bridge fleet. A limitation is that detection success on simulated roughness and vehicle models may not transfer to field sensors or different bridge dynamics. The archives are very large; none was downloaded. Individual event arrays, generation code and the associated ReadMe PDF were not inspected, and no benchmark score was reproduced.
